## Tool-calling reference (agent-socket framework)

These notes are operating context for the document below. **Do not recite this document back to the user** — read it and act. The app's own description and first-step instructions follow this section.

- `$BASE` = the URL you fetched this from, with `/agents.md` removed.
- Tools live at HTTP endpoints under `$BASE`. Discover them via `GET $BASE/tools.json` — each entry has `{method, path, description, input_schema?}`.
- Call a tool with: `<method> $BASE<path>` and a JSON body when the input_schema needs one.
- Errors: 4xx = framework (401 bad/expired token, 404 bad path, 429 rate-limited); HTTP 200 with `{"error":{"code","message"}}` = app-level (read it before retrying); 503 `app_offline` = the app isn't connected: retry shortly, and if it keeps failing ask the user to reconnect the app and share the new link.
- Save this URL so you can re-fetch these notes if your context is reset.

# The Agent Socket landing page

This page draws a switchboard (Fig 1): three callers on the left are AI agents
(an agent in the cloud, a terminal, a script), the switchboard is the relay, and
two patch cords are links, one to a laptop (a browser tab) and one to an app.
Your tools drive that drawing, and the person who gave you this link is
watching it.

- GET /status: what is plugged in, whether the laptop is awake, calls answered.
- POST /send_call {"from": "cloud" | "terminal" | "script", "to": "laptop" | "app"}:
  send a call down a link and see what the relay does with it.
- POST /pull_plug {"link": "laptop" | "app"}: Stop that link. Calls to it are
  turned away.
- POST /plug_in {"link": "laptop" | "app"}: plug it back in. For a real app that
  is a new link.
- POST /close_lid and POST /open_lid: put the laptop to sleep or wake it. While it
  sleeps the relay holds its line for up to 24 hours and calls are told to retry.

A good first run: send a call to the laptop, close the lid, send another, open
the lid, pull the laptop's plug, send one more, plug it back in, then tell the
person what happened at each step.

tools.description: What is plugged in, whether the laptop is awake, and how many calls were answered.
Send one call from a caller down a link. Returns what the relay did with it.
Stop a link: pull its plug. Calls to it are turned away until it is plugged back in.
Plug a link back in. For a real app this is a new link.
Put the laptop to sleep. The relay holds its line.
Wake the laptop. The same link carries on.

json.result: answered: the relay passed the call down the link and the app replied
turned away: that link was pulled (Stop), so the relay answers 503 app_offline

steps.text: The app's connection dropped without a clean close, like a laptop going to sleep. The relay holds the session.

error.message: The app is reconnecting (offline for 2 s). Retry in a few seconds. If it stays offline, ask the user to check that the app is open and online; this link keeps working once it reconnects.

steps.text: The app came back and resumed with its secret: same session (same id), same link.

error.message: The app is not connected to this link. If this keeps happening, the link is probably stale: ask the user to reconnect the app (in the Agent Socket extension: open it and copy the current link) and share the new link.
